title: Fix an endpoint in place
description: Attach the SNMP driver with its host typed one octet short, then correct the host on the endpoint itself and watch samples arrive, with no re-attach.

steps.caption: A display in Bay 2, with no endpoint yet.
Add an endpoint, the way a node reaches the display.
The SNMP driver reads the uptime any agent reports.
The host is the display's address, typed one octet short.
The community is a secret's name, never its value.
Attach it. The endpoint opens; nothing answers at that address, so nothing is collected.
Its inputs edit in place, the same ones the attach asked for.
Add the missing octet. The driver checks the value, and the target moves with it.
Save. No re-attach; the node reconnects on the new address at its next check-in.
Its Overview reads the display as it is collected.
Samples arrived. The uptime the display reports now lands.
